summary: 水母聚集本是一些海域的自然现象，但过度捕捞等变化可能让水母在生态竞争中占优。水母大量摄食鱼卵及幼鱼所需的浮游生物，又会阻碍鱼群恢复，影响渔业。
logic: 区分自然聚集与异常暴发

paragraphs.brief: 水母已经成为海滩假日的诅咒渗透到全球的海洋北极和热带地区繁荣
sentences: Jellyfish have become the curse of beach holidays, permeating every ocean on the globe, thriving in the Arctic and the tropics.
水母已经成为海滩假日的诅咒渗透到全球的海洋北极和热带地区繁荣
In an ever-changing world where other species struggle to endure, jellyfish populations are on the rise.
在一个不断变化的世界中，其他物种挣扎着忍受，水母种群在增加。
To the untrained eye, these creatures drift aimlessly on the oceans’ currents and appear benign.
在未受过训练的眼中，这些生物无目的地漂浮在洋流上看上去是良性的。
In addition, they lack sharp claws, piercing teeth or even a brain.
此外，他们缺乏利爪、刺牙甚至大脑。
Despite this, they are armed with an amazing arsenal of weapons, especially the stinging power of their tentacles.
尽管如此，他们仍拥有惊人的武器库，特别是触角的刺痛力量。
As a result, jellyfish are among the most-feared, least-understood creatures in the seas.
因此，水母是海洋中最害怕、最不了解的生物之一。

paragraphs.brief: 美国南阿拉巴马大学水母科学家Monty Graham博士指出，“水母是跟踪沿海生态系统的相当不错的动物群。
sentences: According to Dr Monty Graham, a jellyfish scientist at the University of South Alabama, US, ‘Jellyfish are a pretty good group of animals to track coastal ecosystems.
美国南阿拉巴马大学水母科学家Monty Graham博士指出，“水母是跟踪沿海生态系统的相当不错的动物群。
When you start to see jellyfish numbers grow, that usually indicates a stressed system.’
当你开始看到水母数量增长时，这通常表示一种压力系统。
While populations appear to be down this year, Dr Graham sees ‘a statistically solid increase’ over the longer term.
虽然今年人口似乎减少，但Graham博士认为，从长远来看，“从统计学上看，增长是实实在在的”。

This increase first gained attention in the 1980s when a huge number of jellyfish, Atlantic Ocean natives named Mnemiopsis leidyi, devastated the Black Sea, an ecosystem already weakened by overfishing of anchovies.
这一增长在1980年代首次引起人们的关注，当时大量水母，即名叫Mnemiopsis Leidyi的大西洋本地人摧毁了黑海，而黑海的生态系统已经因凤尾鱼过度捕捞而削弱。
Scientists believe that this species of jellyfish came in on the bottom of a ship and then rapidly multiplied, feeding on anchovy eggs and the plankton that young fish rely on.
科学家们相信，这种水母物种出现在船底然后迅速繁殖，食用鱼群中的鱼卵和浮游生物。

paragraphs.brief: 高温水母群集可以成为健康海洋生态系统的一个自然特征，但现在全世界正在出现更加严重和频繁的水母爆发。
sentences: Dense jellyfish aggregations can be a natural feature of healthy ocean ecosystems, but a clear picture is now emerging of more severe and frequent jellyfish outbreaks worldwide.
高温水母群集可以成为健康海洋生态系统的一个自然特征，但现在全世界正在出现更加严重和频繁的水母爆发。

Dr Anthony Richardson, from the University of Queensland, Australia, explains that once jellyfish gain a foothold, if conditions are right, they can establish a massive population at the expense of other ocean life.
澳大利亚昆士兰大学的Anthony Richardson博士解释说，如果条件合适，水母一旦站稳脚跟，就可以以牺牲其他海洋生物为代价，建立大批种群。
The problem is that parts of the ocean might switch from being dominated by fish to being dominated by jellyfish.
问题在于，海洋的某些部分可能会从鱼类主宰转变为水母主宰。

paragraphs.brief: 鱼避免了低氧水体避免了水母氧气需求较低不仅生存下来而且在这种条件下也能繁荣发展因为鱼的掠夺和竞争较少
sentences: A study done by Richardson and his colleagues explores the causes behind jellyfish infestation, and the need for swift, decisive action to stem the jellyfish takeover.
Richardson和他的同事进行的一项研究探讨了水母受到感染的原因，以及迅速采取果断行动制止水母接管的必要性。
Jellyfish outbreaks are linked directly to human actions, including overfishing, the input of fertilizer and sewage into the ocean, and climate change.
水母爆发与人类行动直接相关，包括过度捕捞、肥料和污水流入海洋以及气候变化。
Overfishing has removed fish from marine ecosystems at astounding rates.
过度捕捞以惊人的速度将鱼类从海洋生态系统中清除出来。
According to Richardson, this has made it possible for jellyfish to take their place.
理查森说这让水母取代了他们的位置
‘This is because small fish appear to keep jellyfish in check by predation (on jellyfish when they are very small) and competition (when feeding).
这是因为小鱼似乎通过捕食(在水母非常小的时候)和竞争(在喂食的时候)来控制水母。
So, once we remove fish, jellyfish can proliferate.’
因此，一旦我们除去鱼，水母就会扩散。
Eutrophication is another human-caused change in the ocean that has likely contributed to jellyfish explosions.
富营养化是海洋中另一个由人类引起的变化，它可能促成水母爆炸。
Eutrophication is an increase in nitrogen and phosphorus in the ocean, largely caused by fertilizer and waste run-off.
富营养化是海洋中氮和磷的增加，主要是化肥和废物流失造成的。
This leads to algae blooms, which lower oxygen in the marine ecosystem, creating so-called ‘dead zones’, which have been increasing dramatically around the world.
这导致了藻类的开花，降低了海洋生态系统的氧气，创造了所谓的“死区”，在世界各地，这种区一直在急剧增加。
According to Richardson, these low-oxygen waters give jellyfish the advantage.
根据理查森的说法这些低氧水体给水母带来了优势
‘Fish avoid low-oxygen waters but jellyfish, having lower oxygen demands, not only survive but can thrive in these conditions as there is less predation and competition from fish.’
鱼避免了低氧水体避免了水母氧气需求较低不仅生存下来而且在这种条件下也能繁荣发展因为鱼的掠夺和竞争较少

paragraphs.brief: 许多有毒水母物种是热带物种，可以移入人口密度较高的亚热带和温带地区。
sentences: Furthermore, Richardson and his colleagues speculate that climate change may expand the traditional geographical range of jellyfish.
此外，Richardson和他的同事推测，气候变化可能会扩大水母的传统地理范围。
‘As water warms, tropical species are moving towards the poles.
热带物种正向极地移动。
Many venomous jellyfish species are tropical and could move into more densely populated subtropical and temperate regions.’
许多有毒水母物种是热带物种，可以移入人口密度较高的亚热带和温带地区。

paragraphs.brief: 一旦水母聚集在生态系统中它们就很难让鱼们重新回到原点
sentences: Once jellyfish appear en masse in an ecosystem, they can make it very difficult for fish to stage a comeback.
一旦水母聚集在生态系统中它们就很难让鱼们重新回到原点
By feeding on fish, the jellyfish successfully prevent fish from returning to their normal population numbers, says Richardson.
理查森说的：“通过食用鱼类，水母成功地阻止了鱼类恢复到正常人口数。”
‘One can thus think of two alternate states with each being stable: one dominated by fish and the other by jellyfish.
人们可以想到两个不同的状态，每个状态稳定：一个是鱼类，另一个是水母。
Unfortunately, where there is a jellyfish-dominated state then this does not support the nutritional needs of other fish, marine mammals, and seabirds.’
不幸的是，如果存在水母为主的状态，则无法满足其他鱼类、海洋哺乳动物和海鸟的营养需求。
In other words, an ecosystem that loses fish also loses the species that depend on fish for survival.
换句话说，一个失去鱼类的生态系统也会失去靠鱼类生存的物种。
This state has been defined as a ‘monoculture of jellyfish’, an apt analogy since the situation shares similarities with other monocultures.
这一状况被定义为“水母的海洋养殖”，这是一个恰当的类比，因为这种情况与其他单一的养殖有相似之处。

When the rich biodiversity of tropical forests is replaced by plantations growing a single species of tree, an area of rich variety becomes a desert in terms of biodiversity, as do ocean ecosystems when jellyfish become the dominant species.
当热带森林丰富的生物多样性被种植单一树种的种植园所取代时，从生物多样性方面来说，丰富多彩的地区变成沙漠，水母成为主要物种时，海洋生态系统也变成沙漠。
One result of large jellyfish populations is the economic effect it has had on the fishing industry.
大量水母种群的一个后果是它对渔业的经济影响。
In the Gulf of Mexico, shrimp fishermen are struggling with a jellyfish boom that fills nets, causing them to break and resulting in millions of dollars in losses.
在墨西哥湾，捕虾者正与充斥渔网的水母潮挣扎，导致渔网破裂，造成数百万美元的损失。

paragraphs.brief: 专家说，必须更好地了解水母，包括其理想的水温和喂养习惯，才能确定造成最近大规模入侵的原因，并找到打击的方法。
sentences: Experts say that a greater understanding of jellyfish, including their ideal water temperature and feeding habits, is necessary to determine with certainty what is causing the recent massive invasion and to come up with ways to combat it.
专家说，必须更好地了解水母，包括其理想的水温和喂养习惯，才能确定造成最近大规模入侵的原因，并找到打击的方法。
Due to the difficulty of turning ecosystems around once jellyfish have become dominant, Richardson and his colleagues propose focusing on ‘prevention rather than cure’.
由于在水母成为主宰之后生态系统难以扭转，理查森和他的同事建议把重点放在“预防而不是治愈”上。

They recommend a halt to overfishing small fish that are vital to keeping jellyfish in check, reducing the amount of fertilizer and sewage running off into the oceans, and finally, if possible, confronting climate change.
他们建议停止过度捕捞对控制水母至关重要的小型鱼类，减少流入海洋的肥料和污水数量，并在可能情况下最终应对气候变化。

items.en: a prediction as to the direction in which the jellyfish population may spread
items.zh: 预测水母种群可能扩散的方向
items.why: “moving towards the poles”=向两极扩散的方向性预测。

items.en: a description of some physical characteristics of jellyfish
items.zh: 水母的一些物理特征说明
items.why: 题干中的“physical characteristics” 对应 A 段对没有爪/牙/ 脑、触手会折的描写。

items.en: an account of the consequences of jellyfish as lone survivors
items.zh: 水母作为独生子的后果
items.why: “lone survivors”对应低氧等情境下水母存活 OF 段给出生态后果 (食物网受损)。

items.en: suggestions on how to avoid further jellyfish invasions
items.zh: 关于如何避免水母进一步入侵的建议
items.why: G段列出预防建议，包括控制过度捕捞、减少化肥和污水入海，以及应对气候变化。

items.en: The list below gives some effects that jellyfish have had on the world. Which TWO of these effects are mentioned by the writer of the text?
items.zh: 下面的列表给出了水母对世界的一些影响。文本的作者提到了其中的哪些影响？
correct: They have contributed to the decline in the Black Sea anchovy population.
它们促成了黑海鱼群的减少。
They have created financial hardship in the fishing industry.
它们给渔业造成了财政困难。

items.en: Which TWO of the following are possible causes of an increase in jellyfish numbers?
items.zh: 下列两个因素是水母数量增加的可能原因？
correct: a shortage of small fish in the oceans
the dumping of chemicals into the oceans

items.en: Some fish in the oceans may be unable to sustain their population as the jellyfish eat their ________.
items.zh: 水母吃掉某些海鱼的________，可能导致这些鱼无法维持种群数量。
items.why: “sustain their population” 侧重繁殖来源，与“eggs”最佳匹配。

items.en: The state of jellyfish becoming the main ocean species has been named ________.
items.zh: 水母成为海洋优势物种的状态被称为________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“这一状况被定义为“水母的海洋养殖”，这是一个恰当的类比，因为这种情况与其他单一的养殖有相似之处”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Increasing numbers of jellyfish can damage ________ used for commercial fishing.
items.zh: 水母数量增加会损坏商业捕鱼使用的________。
items.why: 了明示被损坏的是渔网。

items.en: Understanding basic facts about jellyfish, such as the ________ of the ocean which suits them best, may help control their numbers.
items.zh: 了解水母的基本习性，比如它们最适应怎样的海洋________，或许有助于控制其数量。
items.why: 回到对应内容“专家说，必须更好地了解水母，包括其理想的水温和喂养习惯，才能确定造成最近大规模入侵的原因，并找到打击的方法”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Richardson believes it is better to direct attention to ________, instead of just trying to solve existing problems.
items.zh: 理查森认为，与其只顾解决已经出现的问题，不如把注意力放在________上。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

points: G段列出预防建议，包括控制过度捕捞、减少化肥和污水入海，以及应对气候变化。
回到对应内容“这一状况被定义为“水母的海洋养殖”，这是一个恰当的类比，因为这种情况与其他单一的养殖有相似之处”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: …, Dr Graham sees ‘a statistically solid increase’ over the longer term.
连接词 while 引出“While populations appear to be down this year”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
连接词 because 引出“because small fish appear to keep jellyfish in check by predation (on jellyfish when they are very small”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
